title: Repair GitHub test-before-approval deadlock and empty-suite false FAIL; generic evidence without fake PASS

why5.question: Why did required Actions show FAIL without running tests?
why5.answer: Four workflows invoked a Human Final Ready preflight before the actual Gate commands, causing an unapproved Draft to exit before true CI, governance, CodeQL and Attack testing.

why5.question: Why could the original real-cloud evidence runner not help other PRs?
why5.answer: The W1-01 runner and workflow dispatch conditional hardcoded PR #395 and its governance docket, preventing new PRs from producing seven-stage execution evidence before approval.

why5.question: Why did closure #398's Fast-loop fail?
why5.answer: Both tests/state-machine and tests/accessibility contain no executable files; the full-fallback loop ran these commands and misclassified no-tests as product failure.

why5.question: Why must the actual security gates remain enforced?
why5.answer: Running the real Gate commands before Human approval is the only way to obtain real results; all existing Gate code, CodeQL analysis, product CI, negative cases and independent merge approval remain applicable.

why5.question: Why separate this repair from Sprint3 administrative closure?
why5.answer: The closure gate permits only five exact state/control files and must independently preserve T006 BLOCKED, T008 REVIEW, F00-AC-037 UNTESTED and all carry-forward items.

alternatives: Run all four real GCCA jobs before Final Ready, keep Human Merge, and provide generic execution evidence: selected.
no_change: Four full workflows report NOT_READY before executing substantive tests; one-time #395 evidence runner cannot serve another PR; no-test families are false failures.
rollback: Human-governed revert of only seven changed workflow/test harness paths after independent gate and source-byte review; never silently revert merged Product truth.
negative_tests: Draft PR: all four real GH gate jobs execute, without preflight. Ready PR: final-ready preflight runs AFTER each real gate, still refusing invalid attestations.
Main push: exact-merged-PR provenance validation remains mandatory before any job; direct Main push is denied.
Generic cloud evidence only runs on PR 'cloud-evidence' label; avoids automatic expensive seven-stage run on unrelated PRs.
Zero test files become NOT_RUN; populated selected families execute and nonzero status still fails.
Human approval/TTL absent in this source-only candidate; subsequent merge is NOT authorized by this commit.
Cloud mirror save()/source.json output paths exactly match its created cloud-evidence/ directory and upload-artifact path.
Required CI job owns its Ready-only Final Ready guard; cloud evidence job does not, avoiding false pass from textual grep across jobs.

Required CI orders npm ci, lint and Product CI BEFORE Human-bound governance/constitutional gates; governance still fails closed on a missing Human decision, but no longer suppresses earlier test results.
Cloud evidence triggers in a dedicated opt-in workflow, while required CI excludes labeled events; no extra required check from a label-only update.

Evidence mirror: exit-0 Product CI HOLD/N/A is recorded NOT_RUN; explicit PRODUCT CI: PASS is required, and FAIL still stays FAIL. New regression cases for HOLD, governance-only, control-only, real Product PASS, bad exit status.
Cloud evidence manifest.not_run includes both previously attempted non-PASS Product HOLD/N/A stages and unexecuted future commands; stage-specific exit codes and logs are preserved.

Four required CI/Governance/Attack/CodeQL checks no longer depend on post-test GPT BCE/Human Final Ready; separate non-required final-ready-audit validates ordered attestations after CI, preserves main-push provenance and independent Human Merge.
Job-aware synthetic audit extracts required ci only until separate final-ready-audit job, never misclassifies downstream non-required job text as an in-gate Human condition.

scope_exception.reason: Direct Human request 2026-10-15 to immediately fix test-first deadlock and PR395-only runner; prepare candidate without opening a PR or merging.
scope_exception.risk: Removing pre-test Final Ready admission may allow CI to execute unapproved candidate source; PR checks run with read-only permissions and no release/deploy step, while independent Human final Merge remains mandatory. Real failures are never converted to PASS.
scope_exception.owner: Human merge approver; GPT candidate author and evidence reviewer
scope_exception.follow_up: Preliminary exact Human candidate approval remains mandatory for constitutional/Governance scope. Required four status jobs can PASS before GPT BCE and final Human Ready; the separate non-required Final Ready audit may be rerun after comment attestations, with independent Human Merge approval still needed. Main push provenance guard remains in all four mandatory workflows.
scope_exception.expires_at_rule: Only set within 14 days of genuine exact-candidate Human approval. No approval is asserted by this draft.

carry_forward.justification: This tooling and workflow repair creates or waives no Product Acceptance/Task/Sprint obligation; open Sprint3 gaps stay open and are handled by their separate closure decision.
